message: So, there I was, enjoying a cozy evening when the lights went out. I remember my partner rolling his eyes as I insisted we keep our power banks charged and our trusty lanterns handy. Fast forward to that moment of darkness: I flipped on the lantern, and he looked at me with that 'I told you so' grin! 🙄 It’s funny how those little preparations turn into big wins when the unexpected happens. What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a power outage?
